treatment.logline: In monsoon Colombo, a humble tea-seller returns a stranger’s fallen phone; a spark flickers until her father’s call ends it, leaving an ambition burning in the rain.

arc.feeling: Grounded, rain-soaked realism; quiet drive beneath hardship.
Gentle warmth under cold rain; curiosity and shy grace.
Tenderness snaps to duty; ache, restraint.
Lingering pull; fate whispers over rain.

treatment.approach: Naturalistic handheld and restrained movement. Let rain texture the frame; warm skin tones and tea steam play against cool, grey monsoon light. Build intimacy through progressive compression: begin wide, then move into OTS and singles. Keep the father disembodied. Pace aims for ~60 s with purposeful beats; use inserts of rain/steam as breathable trims. One deliberate move per shot.

colour_script.palette: Cool greys, slick asphalt blues, desaturated shopfronts; warm amber tea steam and skin tones as contrast.
colour_script.light: Soft overcast toplight with bounce from wet street; low-contrast shadows; practicals on stall warm.
colour_script.grade: Rich but natural; slight cool bias in mids, preserve warm highlights on faces/steam.

colour_script.palette: Cool rain and car neutrals, subtle jewel tones in Anudi’s blouse; Kasun’s muted wardrobe anchors realism.
colour_script.light: Consistent rain softbox; umbrella adds specular highlights and droplets.
colour_script.grade: Neutral-warm skintone isolation; gentle halation on raindrops.

colour_script.palette: Same base; a touch more warmth in midtones to echo connection.
colour_script.light: Softer front fill from umbrella, background rain stays textured.
colour_script.grade: Slight contrast lift; keep color natural.

colour_script.palette: Cooler shift; slight desaturation as tone turns serious.
colour_script.light: Phone screen glow on Anudi’s face; rain persists; no readable text.

colour_script.palette: Return to cool-warm mix; Kasun isolated against grey street with warm stall behind.
colour_script.light: Back rain sparkle; soft rim; distant traffic bokeh.
colour_script.grade: Clean, natural; subtle vignette to hold gaze.

treatment.geography: Kasun’s three-wheeler stall sits curbside on a narrow Colombo road; counter and tea flask under a small awning. Puddles at the curb; traffic and tuk-tuks pass behind. Anudi’s family car stops across the road; she steps out with umbrella, crosses toward stall area where she drops phone near the three-wheeler. Movement stays along the curb; we never enter the road dangerously. Lines of sight: Kasun usually frame-left toward road; Anudi approaches from frame-right.
treatment.key_image: Kasun in a medium close under the awning edge, rain threading the background, holding Anudi’s phone out as droplets bead on his stubble; her umbrella edge softens the top of frame.
advice: Keep rain continuity: droplet density and garment wetness consistent per moment.
Never show Father; his line plays over Anudi/Kasun or rain details.
Avoid readable phone UI; use vibration/ring, screen glow only.
Let SFX carry realism: rain, traffic wash, kettle hiss; mix Father/Narrator dry but placed.
One move per shot. Favor locked-off for dialogue clarity in rain.
Protect faces from raindrops on lens; allow controlled droplets for texture.

sequences.title: Rain and ambition
sequences.purpose: Establish rain world and Kasun’s drive; seed his inner vow.

sequences.title: Curiosity
sequences.purpose: They exchange thanks and a curious question.

sequences.title: Opening up
sequences.purpose: Kasun shares his start and dream; warmth blooms.

sequences.title: The interruption
sequences.purpose: Phone rings; Father’s demand breaks the mood.

sequences.title: Goodbye pull
sequences.purpose: A last look; she leaves; he watches.

moments.what: Heavy rain over Colombo; Kasun works his small stall, eyes hint at bigger dreams.
moments.feeling: Immersed in rain; respect for his grind.
moments.cut_uses: Start on a WIDE master under rain (locked_off) to place world, then push-past-foreground droplets into a MS of Kasun at stall.

moments.what: Kasun’s inner vow plays over his face and rain texture.
moments.cut_uses: Hold a MCU single on Kasun (shallow_isolation) while the thought L3 plays V/O; lips closed.

moments.what: Anudi steps from car with umbrella; drops her phone near the stall.
moments.feeling: A graceful arrival with a human slip.
moments.cut_uses: A MWS two_shot from stall side to catch her approach and the drop; then an INSERT of phone landing in puddle splash.

moments.what: Kasun grabs the phone and hurries after her.
moments.cut_uses: Handheld MS follow on Kasun (follow) leaving stall; rain adds urgency.

moments.what: He calls out; she turns to him.
moments.cut_uses: Over-the-shoulder from Kasun onto Anudi as she turns; line L7 performed on Kasun single, then match to her reaction.

moments.what: She thanks him and admires his work; she asks a curious question.
moments.cut_uses: Two_shot MS under umbrella edge; alternate singles for L9 and L11 for clarity.

moments.what: He smiles and shares his bootstrap story; she smiles back.
moments.cut_uses: Kasun MCU single for L13 (primary); intercut her soft reaction and a cutaway of steaming tea.

moments.what: Her phone rings; Father’s voice demands she come home; her face falls.
moments.cut_uses: INSERT of vibrating phone in hand as ring starts; then Anudi CU single during Father’s V/O; no one else speaks.

moments.what: She holds a last look, then walks away; he watches, rooted.
moments.cut_uses: Clean_exit of Anudi walking out of a held two_shot; then reaction single on Kasun watching through rain.

moments.what: Her soft promise, then narrator’s fate line over Kasun in rain.
moments.cut_uses: L19 on Anudi single; then transition to Kasun MS with rain, while Narrator V/O L22 plays; end on lingering master.

editor_notes: Intended cut length target ~60 s. Build with economical coverage; inserts of rain/steam serve as breath and trim points.
Do not show Father; his line L16 plays over Anudi/Kasun or rain details. L3 and L22 are V/O; no lips move.
Dialogue priority: L7 on Kasun single; L9 and L11 on Anudi single then two_shot for presence; L13 on Kasun MCU; L19 on Anudi single. Masters carry room and safety under rain.
Use one controlled motion per clip (follow, push-past-foreground, shallow_isolation) and otherwise hold locked-off frames for dialogue intelligibility in rain noise.
Protect continuity of rain intensity, wet wardrobe, umbrella positions and stall props per moment.
